designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless smooth-domed head with telescoping inner jaw, one ribbed torso, exactly two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one continuous segmented tail. No residual human features and no equipment.

designDetails.scale: Use the reviewed base dome-to-ribcage, shoulder-to-pelvis and limb-mass relationships as anatomical guidance only.
